description: This file defines the RezKonv class, which extends the Integration class to parse recipe files, extract recipe data, and create database objects for recipes, ingredients, and steps. It also includes a method to split recipe files based on encoding and delimiters.

classes.name: RezKonv
classes.description: A class that extends Integration to parse recipe files, extract recipe data, and create corresponding database objects.

methods.name: get_recipe_from_file
methods.description: Parses a recipe file to extract title, categories, ingredients, and directions, then creates and returns a Recipe object.

methods.name: get_file_from_recipe
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended to generate a file from a recipe.

methods.name: split_recipe_file
methods.description: Splits a recipe file into individual recipes based on delimiters and encoding detection.
